requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity features and scan workflow solutions to enhance business manageability for SMBs. Includes AI-driven print and scan optimization, automated workflows, and device management capabilities.
requirements.Rationale: AI solutions are a key differentiator for Magellan, addressing SMB needs for efficiency and ease of management without dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features must be integrated and demonstrably improve productivity and manageability; validated through user testing and performance benchmarks.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage multiple printers, including device status, usage analytics, maintenance alerts, and remote configuration.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs require easy, centralized management as they lack dedicated IT teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal must support multi-device management, provide real-time analytics and maintenance notifications, and be accessible via web and mobile.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO for SMBs, including cost-efficient consumables, minimal intervention, and high-yield ink tanks.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a primary buying factor for SMBs; HP must compete on TCO to win market share.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO must be demonstrably lower than competitors in independent testing; consumables must be cost-effective and require minimal replacement.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Provide a maintenance box that is easily replaceable by customers, minimizing service intervention and downtime.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need minimal maintenance and fast recovery; reducing service calls improves efficiency and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box must be replaceable by end-users with clear instructions; validated through usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent incorrect filling and ensure ease of use.
requirements.Rationale: Keyed bottles reduce user errors and streamline maintenance for SMBs with limited technical expertise.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles must be keyed and prevent incorrect refilling; validated by error rate reduction in testing.

requirements.Title: High-Yield Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Equip Magellan with high-yield ink tanks for extended printing capacity and reduced refill frequency.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs print high volumes and need efficient, low-intervention consumables.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink tanks must support AMPV of 500 pages/month for 2 years or 80k pages, whichever is first.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, to assure reliability and value.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need predictable, reliable service and coverage for high-volume use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms must be documented, and coverage validated for both page count and time duration.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Printing as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Enable Magellan to support Printing as a Service (PaaS), including subscription management and advanced portal integration.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS is a strategic goal for HP and aligns with SMB needs for flexible, managed services.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must integrate with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, supporting PaaS workflows.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Provide PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript) support for PDL SKU, including speed improvements (target 25/20 min).
requirements.Rationale: PDL/PS support is required for advanced office environments and compatibility with business workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU must achieve target speed and support PDL/PS protocols; validated by performance testing.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan meets Blue Angel environmental certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Blue Angel certification is required for compliance and competitive positioning in certain markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must pass Blue Angel certification tests and documentation.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan
requirements.Description: Deliver superior print and scan quality through AI-driven optimization, ensuring consistent results and minimal errors.
requirements.Rationale: Print and scan quality is a top customer need and competitive differentiator.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print and scan quality must exceed industry benchmarks and be validated by independent testing.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Use 60% recycled content plastic in Magellan’s construction, exceeding competitor standards (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and meets regulatory and customer expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer construction must be validated to use 60% RCP; confirmed by supply chain audits.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a growing need for SMBs, supporting flexible work environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must support HP App integration and allow remote/mobile print jobs.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for remote monitoring, usage analytics, and predictive maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry improves manageability, supports PaaS, and enables proactive support for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry must provide real-time data, analytics, and alerting; validated by system integration tests.
